items.headline: ECB opens its Appia tokenization tests to industry groups
items.summary: The Eurosystem invited groups of firms to join practical work on Appia, its plan for a European tokenised market. There are three tracks: tokenised deposits, tokenised securities, and rules for shared networks. Firms must apply as a group, not alone. First-round applications close December 11. The same day, Lagarde put the global tokenised-asset market at about €23 billion.
items.whyItMatters: Europe is choosing the settlement rails and rules that tokenized assets will run on. Commodities aren't in this first call, but the network rules could shape how any tokenized asset is checked.

items.headline: XRPL lending upgrades gain votes, still short of 80%
items.summary: Validator support for the XRP Ledger's built-in lending features rose this month. As of Nov 20, Single Asset Vault (XLS-65) had 25 of 34 recent validator votes. Lending Protocol (XLS-66) and its V1_1 fix had 24 each, up from 22 on Nov 9. Activation needs more than 80% support held for 14 days. None is counting down yet.
items.whyItMatters: If both activate, XRPL tokens, commodity tokens included, could be pooled in vaults and lent on-ledger. That would be a new place for supply to sit, alongside the AMM pools ReserveWatch reads today.

items.headline: Gold heads for its worst week since March
items.summary: Spot gold fell about 3% on Friday, Nov 20, to its lowest level since September 2025. FXStreet and CoinDesk tied the slide to expectations of more Federal Reserve rate hikes and rising inflation-adjusted yields. CoinDesk put gold down 15% for the quarter.
items.whyItMatters: A gold token should move with spot, not away from it. On Sunday, Nov 22, the main XRPL pool for Assetiko's XAUa (about $1.96M) priced it within 0.13% of spot gold.
